changelogversion.changelogtext: Added 'Far Cry' engine (NearChuckle). Featuring:
- New OpenGL ES 3 renderer: every graphics setting up to 'Very High'
- Runs on 64-bit and 32-bit ARM devices
- Widescreen: wider view with scopes, binoculars, radar and HUD kept in shape ('Widescreen fix' option)
- Full touch controls
- Scope button: tap for the scope, slide up or down to zoom
- Aim assist for touch and gamepad: Off, Light, Strong or Snap
- Full gamepad support
- Custom touch buttons, bindable in the Controls menu
- Touch keyboard for the console and text entry
- Resolution and 'Max FPS' options (60 FPS by default)
- 'Bullet decals' option to keep the frame rate up when firing
Q4: Updated to openQ4 0.13.2 (saves not compatible)
Q4: Fixed broken shadows
AVP: Fixed all text input issues
Added 2 gamepad 'Shift Key' buttons
Added 'Quake 4' using openQ4 as the engine
Added 'Alien vs Predator' engine (NakedAVP)
Added tick-rate setting for UE1 multiplayer
Fixed botmatch for UE1
Fixed console height for UE1
Fixed console height for UT99
Fixed collision hash for UE1 and UT99
Added 'dodge' arrows for UE1 and UT99 + configurable max dodge rate
Added Voice commands touch button for UT99
Fixed map loading for UT99
Fixed additive lighting causing render errors
Fixed UT99 logging
Fix UT99 on 32bit ARM
Fixed user_files on Secondary storage
Fixed digital move actions for UE1 and UT99
Removed unused files in assets
Added FOV setting to engine options
Fix bug loading level in UE1
Unreal Engine
Unreal Tournament 99 Engine
